prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a hyper-realistic 3:4 vertical portrait of the attached approved-adult person, preserving their exact face, facial structure, likeness, and head position. They are seated, slightly leaned forward, with a relaxed calm expression and hands resting in their lap. Dress them in loose dark robe-like fabric that drapes naturally. Use a smooth rich orange-and-yellow gradient background with a controlled warm key and soft fill to create a glowing cinematic effect and a gentle shadow behind them. Keep the mood artistic, slightly surreal, moody, and golden. Use an 85mm portrait lens at f/2, realistic natural skin texture, subtle film grain, and high detail.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, sexual pose, identity blending, celebrity likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, text, extra fingers, deformed
